Stormbreak 0.8.2 - Room to dodge

- Shared escape-route protection across all difficulties, bosses and minibosses.
- Overlapping volleys leave room for a dodge; blocking escorts can peel away.
- Aimed shots and late dodges remain dangerous.
- Automatic update checks on launch and when returning to the app.
- Existing saves and achievements are retained. New runs use updated balance records.
